_meta.purpose: Per-signal weights and hard-limit rules for the Authenticity Layer scorer. Read at startup by the authenticity service; persisted per-emerging-topic to the `authenticity_signals` audit table at scoring time so weights can be tuned without losing history.
_meta.calibration_status: PLACEHOLDER — v1 weights are heuristic. Phase 5 backtest will replay 2022-2025 data against known pump-and-dump events to recalibrate. Open Question #5.
_meta.value_normalization: Each signal_value is normalized to [0, 1] where 1 = looks fully organic, 0 = looks fully orchestrated.
review_checklist_for_user: Are the 10 signals' relative weights sensible to your intuition?
account_age_distribution + cross_platform_signature both at 0.15 — should one dominate?
Are the hard-limit thresholds tight enough? (loose = misses pumps; tight = false positives on real virality)
Should suppression cutoff stay at 0.5, or shift to 0.45 (more permissive) / 0.55 (stricter)?
Should borderline range stay at [0.5, 0.65), or widen to [0.5, 0.7)?

weighted_signals.rationale: Highest weight — coordinated buy-rates always rely on bulk-created accounts. Real consumer adoption draws from a mix of long-tenured users.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: Concentrated in one platform / few communities
weighted_signals.organic_pattern: Spreads naturally across communities and source-types
weighted_signals.rationale: Joint highest — pumps are platform-bound (paid one shop). Real virality leaks across platforms within days.
Strong signal but easier to fake with scheduling tools.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: All accounts only post about this one thing
weighted_signals.organic_pattern: Accounts have varied posting history across topics
weighted_signals.rationale: Per-account topic-diversity proxy. Real adopters have lives.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: All top-level, no replies, no back-and-forth
weighted_signals.rationale: Reply ratio + nested-reply depth. Pumps don't argue with themselves.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: Low quality, new accounts, no relevant community history
weighted_signals.rationale: Per-source quality proxy: HN karma, Discord roles/age, forum post-count, Bluesky handle age.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: Comments cluster suspiciously close in embedding space (LLM-generated or copy-paste)
weighted_signals.rationale: Mean pairwise embedding cosine. AI-pumped content collapses into a tight cluster.

weighted_signals.phony_pattern: Same usernames pushing across multiple 'trending' tickers in last 90 days
weighted_signals.organic_pattern: Each ticker has a different population
weighted_signals.rationale: Network signal — flags professional pumpers running multiple campaigns.
Lower weight — easy to fake by varying phrasing without changing intent.
Lower weight — only useful where moderation is observable (HN, Discord, forums). Bluesky / 4chan effectively unmoderated.

hard_limit_rules.description: >=80% of mentioning accounts have age < 30 days
hard_limit_rules.rationale: Statistically impossible for organic emerging trend; signature of bulk account farming.

hard_limit_rules.description: >=50% of mentions occur within a single 4-hour window
hard_limit_rules.rationale: Coordinated activation. Real virality builds across days.

hard_limit_rules.description: >=70% of mentioning accounts fail the per-source quality threshold (HN karma < 50; Discord age < 30d with no role; forum post-count < 5; Bluesky handle age < 30d)
hard_limit_rules.rationale: Per-source quality floor. Real subject-matter communities have established voices.

hard_limit_rules.description: The same username appears as a top mentioner across >=5 'emerging' microcap tickers in the last 90 days
hard_limit_rules.rationale: Single-account signature of a paid promoter rotating campaigns.

suppression_cutoff.behavior: authenticity_score < 0.5 -> suppression_reason='LIKELY_INAUTHENTIC'; emerging_topic persisted, market_situation NOT created; visible only with ?include_suppressed=true

borderline_range.behavior: Scenario surfaces but with AUTHENTICITY_BORDERLINE validity flag (yellow chip; operator review recommended before sizing)

per_source_quality_thresholds._note: Used by HL_LOW_QUALITY_DOMINANCE and account_quality signal value computation. Per-source because quality proxies vary by platform.

fourchan_biz._note: anonymous; quality proxy = posting history within thread + tripcode reputation if present
